get.description: Read a page of objects of a specified type in your HubSpot account. You can control the data returned by specifying properties, associations, and archived status through query parameters. This endpoint supports pagination to navigate through large sets of objects.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

post.description: Create a CRM object with the given properties and return a copy of the object, including the ID. Documentation and examples for creating standard objects is provided.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Archive a batch of CRM objects identified by their IDs. This operation moves the specified objects to the recycling bin, effectively archiving them. It is useful for managing large sets of objects that need to be archived simultaneously.

Create a batch of CRM objects of a specified type in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to create multiple objects in a single request, which can be useful for bulk data imports or synchronizing data from external systems. The response will include the created objects along with their IDs.

Retrieve a batch of CRM objects by their internal IDs or unique property values. This endpoint is useful for obtaining multiple objects in a single request, which can enhance performance and reduce the number of API calls needed. The response can include archived objects if specified.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

post.description: Update a batch of CRM objects specified by their type. This endpoint allows you to modify multiple objects in a single request, ensuring efficient updates to your CRM data. The request body must include the objects to be updated along with their properties.

Create or update a batch of CRM objects based on unique property values. This endpoint allows you to efficiently manage large sets of objects by either creating new entries or updating existing ones in a single request. It is particularly useful for synchronizing data from external systems with HubSpot.

Permanently delete a contact and all associated content to comply with GDPR regulations. This endpoint allows you to use the optional 'idProperty' set to 'email' to identify the contact by email address. If the email address is not found, it will be added to a blocklist, preventing future use.

Merge two CRM objects of the same type within your HubSpot account. This operation combines the properties and associations of the specified objects into a single object, identified by the primary object ID. Use this endpoint to consolidate duplicate records or unify data.

Search for CRM objects of a specified type using various filters and criteria. This endpoint allows you to retrieve objects based on specific properties and conditions, providing flexibility in querying your CRM data. The search results include the total number of objects matching the criteria.

get.description: Read an object identified by `objectId`. By default, `objectId` refers to the internal object ID, but it can be any unique property value specified by the `idProperty` query parameter. You can control the response content using the `properties` query parameter.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory

delete.description: Move an Object identified by `{objectId}` to the recycling bin. This operation allows you to archive a specific CRM object by its type and unique identifier, effectively removing it from active use while retaining the option to restore it later if needed.

patch.description: Perform a partial update of an object identified by `{objectId}`. The `{objectId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query parameter. Provided property values will be overwritten, while read-only and non-existent properties will be ignored. Properties can be cleared by passing an empty string.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type
